title: Comparing cone and degreewise split boundaries
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and let $S=(A^\bullet\xrightarrow{i}B^\bullet\xrightarrow{p}C^\bullet)$ be a short exact sequence of integer cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Fix a splitting $(r^k,s^k)$ of every row, so $i^k r^k=1$, $s^k p^k=1$, and $r^k i^k+p^k s^k=1$ in diagrammatic composition. The cochain boundary $d:C^\bullet\to A^\bullet[1]$ of [lem-weil-pbc-degreewise-split-connecting-morphism] has component $s^k d_B^k r^{k+1}$. Under the localization functor $Q$ and its canonical shift comparison, the canonical cone boundary of the short exact sequence [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle] equals $Q(d)$.

source.place: Tags 0152 and 06XR; split boundary components as in homology.tex Tag 011J

proof.text: Use the degreewise splitting to express the differential of B as the matrix with diagonal entries d_A and d_C and upper-right entry s d_B r. The latter is the boundary cochain map.

Let q:Cone(i) -> C be the canonical cone comparison. In diagrammatic composition its split-boundary composite differs from the third cone map by d_Cone H + H d_{A[1]}, where H^k=proj_B r^k: Cone(i)^k -> A[1]^{k-1}. Expanding the cone differential and d_{A[1]}=-d_A gives proj_A + proj_B (d_B r - r d_A) = proj_A + proj_B p s d_B r. This is q followed by the split boundary minus the third cone map -proj_A, using r i+p s=1, i r=1, and i d_B=d_A i.

The cone comparison q is a quasi-isomorphism. Apply Q to the homotopy and cancel Q(q). The defining cone formula for the canonical SES boundary and the shift comparison of Q give the asserted equality.

lean.statement:
theorem triangleOfSESδ_eq_degreewiseSplit
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C]
    (S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ)) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (σ : ∀ k : ℤ,
      (S.map (HomologicalComplex.eval C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) k)).Splitting) :
    triangleOfSESδ hS =
      ShiftedHom.map (CochainComplex.homOfDegreewiseSplit S σ) Q
